(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining, from the machine-learning algorithm, a database operation predictor that includes at least one of a predicted execution time and an estimated resource cost; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the database constructs and the modified database construct.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 1, further comprising storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the database operation and the database constructs, wherein the database statistics reflect both the predicted execution time and the estimated resource cost relevant to the database operation.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer, with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan, wherein the predicted execution time reflects an estimated resource cost required for executing the query; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time.

(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The method of claim 12, wherein providing further includes providing the database tool within a workload scheduler and management component of a database system to optimize scheduling based on predicted execution times.

(Currently Amended) Claim 18: The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted execution time, wherein the execution resource is selected based on a current performance associated with that execution resource and an estimated resource cost of the least cost query execution plan.
